articles.en_title: Alien: Covenant Follow-Up Adds Prisoners Writer Aaron Guzikowski

articles.en_title: Miami Vice '85 Has Already Triggered My Fandom in Good and Bad Ways

articles.en_title: Mass Effect 5 Details Revealed Following Cancellation, Including 'Hitman-Style Freedom' in Missions

articles.en_title: Yaga Episodes 1 & 2 Recap and Review

articles.en_title: Inde Navarrette Reveals Sneak Peek at Her Rogue Accent Ahead of X-Men Debut

articles.en_title: Humble Bundle’s Sci-Fi Exposure Bundle Is Stacked With 8 Games for $25, Including Marathon

articles.summary: 《Avatar: Seven Havens》第7—9集以重大剧情转折拓展世界观，科拉与阿萨米也再度登场。IGN认为，这三集兼顾悬念、情感与幽默，借各避难所之间的不信任探讨恐惧，并通过出人意料的背叛带来强烈的情感冲击。本文包含完整剧透。

articles.en_title: A Talent for Murder Review
articles.cn_title: 《A Talent for Murder》评测
articles.summary: Anton Corbijn执导的《A Talent for Murder》围绕文学经纪公司员工劝说小说家再写一本书展开，并以戏中戏呈现两人构思的故事。演员对戏默契，摄影与美术出色，但双线叙事削弱了悬念与紧迫感，缺少有力反转，舞台剧改编也未能充分适应电影节奏。
